title: # Build: main-area-tabs (Current profile) - tab group in the console's main area ## What Brett said…
asked: # Build: main-area-tabs (Current profile) - tab group in the console's main area ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 3 2026, voice) "Which build loads the windows in a tab group in the main area?" -> none yet -> "Build that now." Earlier (follow-ups.md): main-area tab group - persistent tabs, right-click for settings, position top/left/right/bottom, drag out to float, drop back to dock, built on the dock engine #245. Also folds in 'detach anything in the main area' (pending plugin-floatable). Book to a free named agent (Polo if his card exists, else Snap Sully). Register id `main-area-tabs` in the `current` profile + banner entry + What Brett said block. Steps through the store. ## Do - s1 The console's **main area becomes a tab group** on the dock engine (src/axf/core/engines/windows.ts, molly-fable #245): every screen/plugin opened in the main area opens as a **tab** (icon, title, close, dirty dot); tabs **persist** across reloads; reopen closed tab; tab overflow scroll + list menu; middle-click/close-others/close-to-right. - s2 **Tab position**: top / bottom / left stack / right stack (setting + right-click on the tab strip). Reuse the Terminal tab-position code if terminal-tabs-left's branch has it (it's paused; don't depend on it). - s3 **Float and dock**: drag a tab out of the strip to make it a floating window (window-resize-fix #278 grips, shared layer); drag a floating window's title onto the tab strip to dock it back (drop indicator); 'Float' / 'Dock' items in tab and window context menus. Any main-area screen can detach (folds in plugin-floatable). Split the main area by dropping a tab on an edge (left/right/top/bottom) using the dock engine. - s4 **Right-click a tab** -> tab context menu with Settings (that plugin's settings), Float, Split, Pin, Duplicate, Close; right-click the strip -> Tab group settings (position, size, show icons, close buttons, max tabs, open new screens as tab vs replace, restore on start, animation). Settings also in main Settings, exposed via REST + MCP + CLI (tabs_list, tab_open, tab_close, tab_float, tab_dock). - s5 Phone: tabs become a compact strip / swipe between tabs, long-press to drag. Tests/type-check, phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/main-area-tabs.md`, THREADS, PR. Commits clean and professional. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches (Brett, Nov 3 2026): a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. An UPGRADE (e.g. Opus → Fable) needs Brett's approval: when you reach one, run `node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs request-upgrade <id> <phase>`, ask once, and stop. Never approve a model switch upgrade yourself (no `act approve` on an upgrade), never relaunch on a higher model.

steps.text: s1 main area tab group on the dock engine (persist, reopen, overflow, close others/right)
s3 float, dock onto strip, split on edges
s4 tab + strip menus, Settings -> Tab group, MCP/REST/CLI tab tools
s5 phone, type-check, screenshots, UI Review, report, PR
